slides.title: Push-to-talk in ATAK
slides.html: OpenDefence Voice is push-to-talk (PTT) voice inside ATAK. You hear your net, the voice channel you joined, with the map still in front of you.

slides.title: Hold to talk
slides.html: Hold the PTT button and talk to your net. It turns red and reads TRANSMITTING while you are on the air.

slides.title: Nothing to sign in to
slides.html: A separate voice app would mean a second sign-in. OpenDefence Voice uses ATAK's own certificate, so it connects by itself and shows Connected.

slides.title: On the thumb bar
slides.html: OpenDefence Voice works on its own, from ATAK's ≡ menu. With OpenDefence Main, Voice on the thumb bar at the bottom left of the map opens it in one tap.

slides.title: Works with the phone locked
slides.html: OpenDefence Voice works with ATAK in the background and the phone locked. Set up in Settings, a PTT button, a headset's talk button or the volume-up key still talks.

slides.title: Ready to talk
slides.html: The notification Voice push-to-talk is ready means the buttons set up in Settings work now, even with the phone locked.
